description: When a session reaches a token or tool-call threshold, it writes a handoff document and starts a fresh session that continues from it, so one long session can never eat your whole context budget.

config.enabled: Master switch. When off, no listeners and no command are registered.
config.tokenThreshold: Token pressure at which the session is handed off.
config.toolCallThreshold: Tool-call count at which the session is handed off; either threshold triggers.
config.handoffDir: Handoff directory relative to the session working directory; default .dsh/handoff.
config.modelSummary: Generate the summary with the model; when off, a local fallback summary costs no extra tokens.
config.chainLimit: Depth limit for the automatic continuation chain; beyond it the document is written but no new session is started.
config.summaryMaxChars: Character cap for the model summary before it enters the document.
config.docMaxChars: Character cap for the whole handoff document.
config.summaryTimeoutMs: Timeout in ms for a single summary model request.
config.maxTrackedFiles: Maximum number of touched file paths listed in the handoff document.
